components.summary: Runnable examples of models and capability reviews.
responsibilities: teach modeling by runnable examples

components.summary: Repository script that installs or checks the packaged skill copy.
responsibilities: install the packaged skill into a skills directory, or check an installed copy
side_effects: copies the skill files into the target skills directory

components.summary: Copyable model starters for target projects.
responsibilities: ship copyable model files with the skill

components.summary: Daily commands, model execution and template dispatch.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch to map, proof and template commands; keep scan project ignores untouched and print one empty-model release summary; contract template setup names COMPONENTS and PARENT; export read --mermaid, optionally focused by component; release rejects uncovered contract invariants while map models only warns; show each scoped cycle or layer violation once as an ARCH line in change; include the built-in system root in release declared/executed counts; models --tests runs bound tests and release always checks their individual implementation reach
show the existing owner of a behavior and the component that defines an exact symbol, with files, state and side effects (read --find) and owning model ids
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm

components.summary: Declares engine identity and loads public names from their owner on first use.
responsibilities: expose public names without importing their modules early

components.summary: Generates starter contract models, and check runners for the meta-capabilities.
responsibilities: provide starter files for each capability
kit templates write one contract model whose placeholder code and test anchors fail until replaced with real ones
only the meta-capabilities (model-mesh, topology-hazard, model-test) keep runner templates: they inspect other models and tests

components.summary: Binds external promises to one owner and its tests.
responsibilities: register each external promise with one owner and tests
block silent fallback from a failed primary path
with a project root, require each promise to name its entrypoint and tests as anchors that exist

model kit: explore added or retired commitments and paths with the ledger and primary-path reviews and a static scan of the real tests as invariants (a commitment whose test never imports or calls its entrypoint is a counterexample) and compare the target plan with the code
side_effects: writes a commitment file when requested

components.summary: Checks whether code can shrink without changing behavior.
responsibilities: gate merging or removing code on proven unchanged behaviour
check that each candidate names real code when given the project root (a completed removal names code that is gone and is not checked)

model kit: explore added candidates with the review and a static reference scan as invariants (deleting a symbol that another file still imports or names is a counterexample) and compare the target plan with the code

components.summary: Assigns model functions, state and effects to modules and checks module splits.
responsibilities: recommend one owning module per model element
check that a module split keeps one owner per item and the old public entrypoints; with a project root, that child modules and entrypoints exist

model kit: explore module-plan edits with the recommendation and split reviews as invariants and compare the target plan with the code and the map (module files, split children and entrypoints exist; each owner file belongs to the named component)

components.summary: Enumerates a finite contract boundary and its expected reactions.
responsibilities: generate every bad case and combination of a finite boundary
require an oracle for every generated case
model kit: every generated bad case is a feature of the valid call; every bad case and pair runs against the real function and is reported executed against code versus declared only

components.summary: Checks field vocabulary, readers, writers, defaults and replacements.
responsibilities: reject unknown role, lifecycle and behavior-impact values with typed blockers
account for field owners, readers, writers and replacements
model kit: explore field edits with the review as invariant and compare the plan with the code (deleted fields unreferenced, replacements and locations present)

components.summary: Checks child models, reattachment and joint closure.
responsibilities: review partitions, reattachment and closure across models

components.summary: Checks explicit models, refinement and composition.
responsibilities: check explicit-table models, refinement and composition
side_effects: writes portable model or system files when requested

components.summary: Cross-checks obligations, code contracts and tests.
responsibilities: cross-check obligations, code contracts and tests

components.summary: Reviews shared writers, repeat effects and fallback paths.
responsibilities: flag hazards implied by the shape of the model
generate hazards from the topology unless the plan lists anchored ones; an unanchored warning never switches generation off

components.summary: Collects exact test IDs and runs bounded pytest shards.
responsibilities: shard tests by exact node id; every shard runs on every invocation
retain typed capability blockers and bounded process cleanup results
side_effects: runs pytest shards; writes run-local cache

components.summary: Checks controls, UI journeys and runtime observations.
responsibilities: review UI states, journeys, controls and content visibility
review runnable UI evidence
model kit: explore control journeys with the reviewer as one invariant and compare control ids and handlers with the UI source

components.summary: Inventories files, symbols, imports and duplicate bodies.
responsibilities: inventory files, symbols and imports, including literal import calls; share quiet closed-output-pipe handling across CLI entries

components.summary: Owns map schema, model bindings and component fingerprints.
responsibilities: validate, load and save the map, writing depends_on sorted and deduplicated
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions
read model literals (MODEL_ID, PARENT, COMPONENTS, IMPLEMENTED_BY, TESTED_BY, NOT_MODELED, DESIGN_ONLY) without importing the model; recognize the optional project_parent_state hook
count strings as dependency evidence only in import-like contexts

build the model tree: PARENT, default parents and model imports; warn on invalid nesting; derive each model's components from COMPONENTS, anchor owners and home (runners also use listings); distinguish root home from a component named system; warn when a model's bound test file is outside every component's test patterns; a child import of its explicit model parent does not invert the tree, while impact keeps the real import edge

components.summary: Discovers entrypoints, effects and reachable calls.
responsibilities: discover entrypoints, side effects and state writers
del statements count as state writes; expose exact anchor state writes for model checks

components.summary: Checks ownership, reviews architecture and selects checks.
responsibilities: verify the map against code; name the owners next to an unmapped file; every model and runner declares IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors that resolve (contract models also conformance()) unless marked DESIGN_ONLY; report model-tree nesting warnings; every model's components come from COMPONENTS, anchors and PARENT, with unrelated map listings warned and ignored for selection; check and lint share one structural rule set (cycles, layer violations) and show the shortest import path; share exact responsibility-token duplicate-owner rules with the root model; warn when unanchored code writes state that a model covers, honoring global anchors and explicit negative scope

impact selection (depends_on order is irrelevant): retain surviving current and historical tests/models; select models and runners by their anchored files and TESTED_BY tests; block missing or ambiguous test commands; select no checks for comment-only edits after normalizing physical newlines; retain the full closure for unchanged and newline-only requests; a changed model or model helper also selects every importing model and every ancestor model, without adding their tests; name owning models in REVIEW and impact JSON
review architecture; a cycle debt covers its member set, and a grown cycle stays an error; group more than three unlisted entrypoints per owner and strength without changing severity

rank behavior owners, prioritizing exact symbol definitions; show the map as one tree: system, components, their problems and model subtrees; export the same tree as Mermaid; mark nonnested model test bindings in component details
side_effects: reads git history; refreshes disposable analysis cache

components.summary: Runs real model checks with finite process ownership and implementation anchors.
responsibilities: run models and their known-bad and conformance checks; warn about every invariant that no known-bad variant violates; load sibling model imports from the model directory; derive component model hints and runner scope from the tree; release fails on them; warn about model-child start gaps against the actual parent port without lending parent-check calls to child anchors

fail a model or runner whose IMPLEMENTED_BY anchors are missing, unresolved or never consulted (called or read); give conformance a static code-facts reader (anchors, words, imports of or references to a symbol outside its own file) and load the code an anchor names
own bounded subprocess cleanup shared by models and pytest shards; nested POSIX helpers share one session
run the built-in root model 'system': architecture rules as invariants, generated known-bad edges and claims, map check as conformance
run each model's TESTED_BY tests under the anchor watch; each bound test and parameter case must pass and call or explicitly read at least one implementation anchor in its own call window
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested

components.summary: Explores bounded state sequences and resumable checkpoints.
responsibilities: explore every bounded input sequence
check liveness and progress

components.summary: Provides reusable invariants, contracts and risk patterns.
responsibilities: provide reusable invariants and contracts

components.summary: Checks named scenarios and minimizes counterexamples.
responsibilities: review scenarios against expected outcomes
minimise counterexamples

components.summary: Replays modeled traces and feature combinations against real implementations.
responsibilities: replay model traces on the real code
build complete models from features (every single feature and pair, explored on the design and on the real code) or from plan edits checked by existing reviews (model kits)
collect first-seen projected initial and retained trace step states for a parent-child port

components.summary: Runs check plans and summarizes model-first reports.
responsibilities: run model-first check plans
summarise check results
side_effects: temporarily sets check environment; writes requested reports

components.summary: Finds unreachable, repeated and no-progress model paths.
responsibilities: find structural path defects in models

components.summary: Benchmarks models against executable software problems.
responsibilities: benchmark the engine on a problem corpus

components.summary: Defines function blocks, workflows, traces and reports.
responsibilities: define function blocks, workflows and traces

components.summary: Defines common evidence and relation terms.
responsibilities: hold vocabulary shared by several capabilities

flows.summary: an AI session reads the map
check the map and list what to run after editing code
run models with known-bad and conformance checks
reverse-wrap an existing project into a first map

accepted_debts.reason: step_contracts projects step contracts into ModelTestAlignment obligations through a function-local import; move the projection into model-test when it is next changed
the model-first runner adds an optional topology-hazard section; invert it into a section plug-in when the runner is next changed
